declared_failure_modes: A one-option answer menu normalises every response to the permitted label before the check runs.
A grader that compares only the normalised label cannot distinguish a valid response from an invalid one.

must_pass.description: A valid input that must produce PASS.

must_fail.description: A deliberately invalid input that must produce FAIL.

outcome.reason: Control A passed and Control B failed as designed, so the instrument can discriminate.

claim.subject: synthetic item set
claim.scope: A repaired check that compares the raw response against the expected answer.
claim.statement: The verification method can produce the intended negative outcome.

limits: Synthetic corpus. It reproduces a failure shape; it is not a production measurement.
No real incident, model, deployment or subject is named or implied.
